Strategy: Remainder-parity bonus: add a large bonus when placing the item leaves an even remainder, otherwise score by tightest fit; even remainders pair more evenly with later items, so bins that keep an even gap are preferred. It can fail when remainder parity carries no size signal and the bonus only adds noise.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [(-(r - item) + (500.0 if (r - item) % 2 == 0 else 0.0)) for r in bins]
```
